limitations: Use the existing positive-kg low-alloyed cast-stock delivery helper. The inspected source has nine deterministic positive producer shares without formulas: three converter and six electric-furnace entries. Their route sums match the existing 0.7421076548969346 converter and 0.2578923451030648 electric coefficients within numerical precision, without renormalization. Existing four barge, road, dry-bulk-ocean and rail delivery quantities and marginal statistics also match. Individual country producer entries are aggregated into two route proxies: complete European converter stock and Swiss electric stock. Country-specific procurement, EAF scrap sourcing, furnace operation, emissions, allocation and internal uncertainty are not reconstructed. This is route-level conservation, not equality of the original nine inventories. Native converter and electric suppliers explicitly include casting and no direct rolling service; Swiss EAF documents economic slag allocation and newer industry data. Preserve signed caller kg, supported uncertainty, formulas and properties at factor +1. Keep complete native steelmaking/casting inventories, alloy/feedstock supplies, internal transport, allocation and emissions once. These references are cast stock, not hot-rolled products or rolling services. Do not add hot rolling, apply a density/alloy/scrap-content/yield factor, graft source energy or emissions onto native inventories, or add recovery credits. Geographic, technology, grade, allocation, internal uncertainty, vintage and native upstream biosphere exclusions remain limitations; score differences are unquantified. Only independently inspected exact ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off is added; existing other-profile decisions and helper inventories stay unchanged.
